sample_selection: Primary Tumor only; smallest sample submitter ID, then smallest aliquot submitter ID, then file UUID. Selection does not use expression or clinical outcomes.
clinical_selection: Use the unique diagnosis with diagnosis_is_primary_disease=true. Do not combine fields from unrelated diagnoses. Unresolved or absent primary diagnoses remain missing.
analysis_scope: Phase 1 only; descriptive statistics; no hypothesis tests, p-values, or regression fits.
